articles.headline: Egypt advance as Iran left to wait after VAR denies late winner
articles.description: Egypt advanced past the group stage at the World Cup for the first time while Iran will have to wait to find out its fate after a 1-1 draw.

articles.headline: Socceroos set to play Egypt in 2026 World Cup round of 32
articles.description: The Socceroos will face Egypt in the round of 32 of the FIFA World Cup, after Belgium's 5-1 win over New Zealand and the Pharaohs' dramatic 1-1 draw with Iran saw them fall to second-place in Group G on goal difference.

articles.headline: Belgium clinch knockout spot as New Zealand exit World Cup
articles.description: Leandro Trossard scored a pair of goals and Belgium overcame a slow start at the World Cup to advance to the knockout round with a 5-1 victory over New Zealand on Friday night.

articles.headline: Marcelo Bielsa after World Cup exit: 'Left nothing' to Uruguay soccer
articles.description: Following Uruguay's group stage exit from the 2026 World Cup, a blunt Marcelo Bielsa conceded that he has "left nothing" to the national team during his time as their coach.

articles.headline: Spain win group but Yéremy Pino could miss rest of World Cup
articles.description: Spain coach Luis de la Fuente has confirmed that the team's qualification for the World Cup knockout stage -- topping Group H after a 1-0 win over Uruguay -- came at a cost, with injury concerns over wingers Nico William
